comment: Lots of horse poop & bugs but beautiful forest nonetheless
Full of shades but not much views to offer.
Around the 3.5km mark there are a lot of downed trunks and branches as you walk through the forest, which can make finding the trail a little challenging.
Gorgeous trail but a TON of Poison Ivy. Also not enough trail markers.

Overall a nice trail but there were some parts about halfway to 3/4 in where the trail was a little hard to follow & there were fallen over trees laying on the trail that required climbing over. 

After that section though it went back to being a solid trail.
just walk

Such a lovely trail.
I love the pond in the little stream
Some parts of the trail was hard to follow due to fallen trees
Agree with the past about horse poop, it was everywhere
Lots of horse poop!

note that the trail as detailed by all trails is a mix of wide trails (some gravel) and narrow (maybe bike?) trails that are dirt. so if it rained recently there might be some mud. 
also be aware horses use these trails as well so there's random piles of poop. 

beautiful wooded trails (especially in the fall). 
some hills interspersed throughout and gentle rises. would recommend looking at @ 3d map and altering your course if the hills are an issue for you.
Nice, clean trail. Terrain was easy to navigate and the views were nice. Definitely recommended!

Superb conditions today!   Our group of 5 and 2 dogs crushed the trails.   Super easy huge parking area. No washrooms. Really needs a portapotty…lets let municipality know!  Gorgeous moraine glory. Large main trails and narrow side trails.

Lots of parking and a nice trail in the forest. There are people on horseback on the trails too but when we were there in the afternoon, they were just walking. Some people mentioned the horse poo but seriously it’s not a problem. A great park for leashed dogs.

This was a brilliant trail with a mix of flat terrain and some inclines/declines in between. We wanted to make it a bit longer so added 4km on top of the 6.6km mentioned on all trails. The parking lot filled up really quickly around 11am. Parts of the trail is shared with horseback riders so expect alot of horse poop. Go with a map because the deeper you go, the harder it becomes to navigate to the correct path as the trails and paths are not marked.
Well maintained, beautiful and interesting hike. Horse manure in many places, but this is nature so just step around it. :)
Lots of poison ivy. Stay on trails.
Beautiful. Quiet. It was a very hot day but with all the forest canopy it was lovely,

big parking, no map so trails confusing without the app, some people doing horse biking riding through trails so there is poop occasionally 

it is cooler on the trails due to the trees
Great hike!
With recent rain this trail was quite dry with a forest ground.   Other than the occasional hiker it was truly a peaceful space.
Incredible forest.  Valleys and creeks.  Amazing trails.  Well protected from windy days. Gorgeous area.
Lovely trails but NO signs. Thank god for this app!!’
Beautiful trail as always. Love here in winter. Some hills but manageable. Lots of trees had spray-paint sign to be cut, wonder what is going on in the forest.

The trail was a bit wet, with some muddy spots, but not a problem at all if you have waterproof shoes. The trails are beautiful and wide, relatively flat. There are some hills if you want a bit more elevation, but if you choose to stay on the main trail I would consider it an easy to moderate Trail, we loved it and we definitely be back.

A trail with a lot of side trails, dog friendly. Very busy on weekends an dholidays so plan accordingly. Can be easy to get lost but eventually you'll find a sign to guide you (or your GPS). Very beautiful trees, only stillwater.
Great view, best fall color in GTA
Good hike. Fall colors starting.
Forest trails, horses also uses this trail.
It's a great trail to take your dog or just hang out in the forest. Beautiful little stream, some big hills but mainly flat. Sandy and rocky paths. Really great for the dog
good trail. easy. went after rain so it was a bit muddy, trees are gorgeous. highly recommend for some moderate exercise.
This trails has the least amount of bugs comparing to my recent trails.
Lots of side trails. Nice spots to sit by the pond. Not buggy! Some trails were marked. Several people on horseback so lots of poop on the trails (not a deal breaker for this one).
Beautiful trail but there is poison ivy all over the place as of today.
Took a shorter custom(1hr) route today. Very nice.
It's suitable for a relaxing trip.
There were a lot of mosquitoes and various flies, not many good views, just an ordinary forest route. The interesting part was encountering two snakes.
Nice trail.  Nice scenery. Bad bad bugs.  Bring bug spray
Nice place to go. Happy Hiking
Much less crowded on weekdays, very peaceful. Mind the mosquitoes
Great selection of trails. Beware of off leash dogs
wide well maintained gravel main trails with smaller trails branching off, nice pond with tiny fish, many log benches along main trails
Nice trail, very quiet
Beautiful wide trails with the option of going on smaller side trails.  Would be ideal for bike riding and walking a stroller. Very few large hills. The pond was just a beautiful spot.
Beautiful day.  No bugs yet!
Loved it
Good hike.
Beautiful trails.
Nice mix of main and side trails. Watch the map, easy to miss a turn.
some downed trees. not impossible to go around.
Beautiful, family friendly.

This was a stunning trail with great side trails. We went with two reactive dogs and the main trails are wide and great for passing. We went from 11:30 to 2 on a Saturday and did side trails and rarely bumped into people. The trail opens into a gorgeous pond area and there were people on horses. What I liked about this was that there were no tall grasses and we did a tick check and nothing so far. Highly recommend getting lost in this forest.
Really lovely hike but mind the map...easy to get off track.
Very easy, wide areas.
Great network of trails. No washroom facilities.

A nice mix of wide track and single track, sand, and hills. 
Nice and quiet this morning.
Some icy and muddy parts in the trail.  Beautiful pine trees
Muddy or icy at this time of year. Still lovely!

Pretty good trail.  Lots of neat trees to see.  Not too many people, lots of parking.  The actual trail isnt marked that well, but with alltrails open, it was easy to get around.  Friendly people on the trail.  Grippers really helped on inclines
Nice trek in the snow
Nice trail. Well marked although a lot of twists and turns.  Not a lot of elevation. Good hike for a winter day.

Great moderate effort trail with some up and downs, narrow sections so tandem only if you're going in groups. Watch out for a lot of parts with compacted and somewhat slippery snow in parts. Really enjoyed it, very quiet and not busy at all around noon on a weekday. Unsure about other times so at your own discretion! Did not see any animals but saw some animal feces, larger size and mostly grassy so I'm assuming deer or the like? Would recommend this trail!
Nice picturesque forest trail

Easy, wide path fairly flat with few roots and rocks. It was tricky to navigate and sometimes we weren’t able to find the path but found others that were close. This could be a good snowshoeing, cross country skiing spot. No washrooms but free parking. I loved the trees even though the leaves have fallen. It smelled so good in the forest. At points you could see some running water and a pond. Watch out for the odd horse droppings.  There are many trails within this area.
Definitely keep all trails open as the sign mark markings are not particularly effective in the side trails
Lovely fall colours
Super rainy but beautiful fall colours.
Beautiful fall colors. very quiet and peaceful
Beautiful! Great fall colours. Very flat and wide path, good for families.
Wow, what a hike! I went right after some rain, and surprisingly, no mud at all. The fall colors were amazing – a perfect day out!

Wish there were more blazes, a bit confusing with all the offshoots that didn’t seem to line up with the trail map accurately all the time. But otherwise, gorgeous day and a beautiful environment to spend it in.
Went in early October. Perfect conditions, dog and I both loved it. Easy walking with a bit more of a challenge if you go off the main trail.
nothing special
Took me about 2 hours to walk the whole thing. I went just after it rained and it wasn't that muddy. I didn't have any problems with bugs. Would walk here again
Perfect conditions
Beautiful green tunnel that everyone will enjoy!
Easily get lost without AllTrails because the area is an intertwined network of trail.
Beautiful peaceful forest, easy to walk, wide paths, not buggy (end of july) despite other comments, but still take bug spray with you. Some truly picturesque spots. Would definitely return.
Lovely day. Great trail conditions.
Bring spray or keep moving because the bugs eat you
There are few bugs and some horse shit. Though the enjoyable part is, the trail is mostly in shade which is a great plus in sunny days.

I absolutely loved this trail, especially the parts where the trail passes through dense forests. There are many wildflowers on the trail, including large patches of trilliums! There are bugs in the trail's open spaces, so bug spray is helpful. There is a small pond in the trail, which is very beautiful. My dog played fetch in the pond and had a great time cooling off after the hike. The trail is well maintained but not well marked, so I suggest that you keep the app open when hiking. There is horse manure on the trail, so watch out cause apparently dogs think it's the best treat ever (10/10 according to my dog).
Beautiful woodland trails with lots of options for shorter or longer hikes. Surprisingly empty on a gorgeous summery Sunday afternoon.
Good trail, mix of open roads and hiking trails in the woods.
Most of the trails are pretty icey and slippery.  It is a bit dangerous if not prepare to walk on ice.
Well maintained, a little icy out today.

Terrific day for a winter hike! Light snow and very little wind. 
This tract is very good for hiking (or cross-country skiing) because you can choose to go 2k or 10k, or anything in between. The numerous trail options let you decide how far you want to go. The trails are generally quite wide and relatively flat, but there are some moderately sized hills.
Ice is starting.
Great loop with barely anyone there - some ice and mud but manageable!
Great hike with my puppy
Very well maintained wide trails, with choice of more rugged routes. A few steep hills, but not too hard.
Horse poo everywhere l
There were a LOT of families on the trails taking their fall photos. Not as peaceful as it could have been. But great trail.
Stunning gal colour today, great walk
Amazing fall hike!!! GORGEOUS!
Beautiful trail especially in the fall. I recommend using the app navigation cause it gets confusing at times. Many ways to turn
Nice trail system. Beware of horse pop
Nice trail, somewhat crowded. Lots of horse poop.
Peaceful and well marked with lots of alternative paths to explore

great trail with the right amount of hills, flat land, tree cover and open air. wasn't that busy when I was there. Only negative was the horse poop on the trail, forced you to look down instead of enjoying the view around you. Would definitely go back.
Got a relax walk in the forest. Definitely an easy trail, not moderate.
one of the better trails when its off the packed path
beautiful trail! lots of choices. well marked trails
Not as long as billed. Just under 7 km. Most is hard packed, some forest trails. Definitely an easy hike, not moderate
Beautiful trail and great for the dogs (on leash!). Great tree cover to keep it shady on hot days.
Well maintained and marked trail system through mostly forested area.  Easy hike for the family.
a really nice trail, but so many bugs. not very busy which was nice!
Too many off lead dogs scaring the wildlife away.
A great trail.
Great place for  hiking! Multiple hiking trails.
It was beautiful and felt fresh!
Beautiful day for a hike and the with the shade you don’t feel the sun as much.
Good for a family walk
So many paths, it’s amazing, not so busy, so much land!
Very good
Fabulous  except too much dog poop at Markham Rd entrance
Great trail
Good footing, not slippery
Beautiful trail! Relaxing and fun.
gorgeous - lots of fresh snow - so beautiful snowshoeing in the forest
The trail was quite snowed under in many spots which made it a cardio beast, however the day was absolutely stunning and the forest is always perfect.
Beautiful.in the sunshine
Really great trail! Cool spot with lots of different tree species. today was pretty busy though.

Nice!
A bit icy in certain areas.
great walk
Loved it! Definitely coming back to do 2-3 hours
Great trail in York Region! Wide paths and totally doable with a stroller for those that want to bring kids & babies along. Will be back.
Great
This was first time hitting this trail in the fall. It was absolutely amazing. I went out early and was the only car in the parking lot when I arrived. Had the whole trail to myself.
path to Lake closed for improvement
Good place.
Great
Nice forest trail. We went on Thanksgiving Monday, and there were a lot of people parked, but the off-official trails were not crowded at all.
Nice, particularly if you go off the beaten path, make your own trail…
So beautiful! Lots to discover we’ll be back for sure
Really well maintained trail. Good for running, hiking and walking, skiing can be done on a part of the trail.
Mostly easy walk. Trees are tall. But not many creeks, which I prefer.
It gets busy around noon, and the busiest part is the trails around the lake
It is a good trail overall just some parts of the trails are unmarked.  Good to have this app so will not go too off track.  Shady and comfortable even for a sunny day.
decent elevation, lovely views, minimal animal activity, lots of horse droppings.
another great walk with my puppy. take some of the side trails it's beautiful in the forest

This morning was absolutely shocking to discover a bonfire by the trees in the parking lot from last night. The sheer ignorance and disrespect of these stupid individuals drinking, littering and potentially causing a massage fire in the forest is shocking to me.
I did report this as soon as I discovered it.
I am beyond disgusted with the lack of respect for our forests, the litter throughout and worse of all the fact that some people feel fine starting a fire.
please report any form of abuse asap if you are aware.
Good trail with lots of paths.  The main blue dotted trails are sandy.  The one complaint is all the horse poop in the middle of the paths.
This is a great trail with sandy paths and  a small pond. It connects to other trails in the area. Do keep in mind its very dusty though.

This is a fantastic loop. A little hard to stay on the trail without following the app as many trail entrances are narrow and slightly hidden when at running speed. Had a nice little tumble that sure woke me up for the rest of the run. Lol.
very serene! lots of ferns! few people once u go off the main trail!
Great and easy walk! Very beautiful
Second time here this year. Went in the winter, it was beautiful. Caters to all families.
Beautiful trail full of trillium.
Nice today in middle spring. Lot of growth. Turtles in pond.
Good hike, a little muddy
Great
Flat wide trails with some elevation. Good for running and walking dogs. Not much to see.
Muddy at places
Very very icy, make sure you have ice cleats on! Beautiful as always

There's no sign in this trail! You can get lost very easily if you decide branch into the woods.
It was beautiful trail but I could not do it without tampon and trekking poles in March. I started late (5pm) and hence these maps are not very precise (I’m new to this app) I had to redo some routes which caused me to finish half an hour later than expected and face the dark while my phone was about to die...I literally cried when I got to the exit.
That wouldn't happen to me with proper signings!
icy, needs to have crampons.
very calm and fairly easy to finish the walk
Very icy but beautiful￼
Lots of trails to hike, can get a bit crowded if you are not there early.
What a gorgeous spot to hike! Lots of space. Tons of trail options. A little interesting being so close to an active archery range, but other than that we loved it.
Lots of options! Nice up and down through ravines.
Great wide trail with pond.

This trail and forest has been incredibly overly packed and high traffic volumes especially on weekends. no social distancing whatsoever and so congested by large groups, the parking lot is always jammed and even the pathway to enter the trail.
I am avoiding this trail for a good while as people are not respecting the law during this pandemic.  I have seen large groups of ppl in the mornings over up to 10 ppl together.  the drive in path is blocked at times even along the outside of the road.
It was ok. Not much change in scenery in the winter.
Good footing for running and walking.
the ice has been covered by the most recent snow. not slippery at all. beautiful!
Very slippery, better to have ice cleats for safety reason. Very beautiful trial, such a winter wonderland!

it was +3C and the snow
 was melting just a little.  Generally ok to walk and run.
Always love the trails through the actual woods in this park

Too icy today. Waaaayyy too icy.
Suspect a good sized bear in there as well. Saw its tracks in the snow a week or so ago and tonight some pretty damned fresh huge digging sites marked with good sized pads/claws. Sure glad I had my pepper spray and spikes on the end of my walking sticks.
Beware of icy trail down to parking lot.  We parked on Hwy. 48. Needs signage. A lovely sunny day-2C. Nice wide and narrow paths with easy hills. Winter wonderland enchantment!
Beautiful!
This was the perfect spot for a day after a snowfall.  We walked on well marked trails for over two hours; saw other people but not too many. It was so pretty we were compelled to take pictures!
Trails off of the main path are lovely, less trafficked, more quiet and easy to navigate even though they're not marked. Overall an easy and enjoyable hike!
Nice trail - pleasant walk on a late November day - the weather Gods were smiling down on us today

Nice brisk evening hike in the first real snow. No critters but I met a cute Irish lass and had a chat on my way out in the dark.  Didn't offer me her cell number either the foolish lady. Sadly, she was heading into the forest alone without a headlamp or pepper spray at the very least. Probably married anyhow. 
Maybe the coyotes or wolves will get her. I warned her so I guess I did all I could. Would have offered to escort her but then I'd be accused of being a forest pervert.

Great trail. Has a parking area. So many good forest trails don’t have parking and too many people these days on the trails. Many york region tickets given out lately. Nice hills and lots of side trails.
not too open, but open enough that it maintains the feeling of being secluded. This trail is more travelled than others in the forest. My dog really enjoyed himself also.
Casual!
This is great trail and more parking than I thought
Lots of trail path options
Wonderful
Too much horse poop
Phone started to die - half our loop!
Some horse poop on the trails, but great fall foliage
Perfect for a Sunday walk with a few inclines. Wide trails but watch out for horse droppings.
Great trail for early morning walk with the dogs!! Easy Hike
Also called Eldred King Woodlands Tract. Nice trail with many side options.
Nice trails with very few trail markings. You could get lost here forever as the woods has no remarkable scenery.
lots of horse manure.
nice trail.  will be good for families with small children as the trail is flat and easy to walk

The trail webs around the forest, less trafficked paths! Can make it longer by joining side trails. The pond is nice, a great place to chill out at. There’s no blazes in the paths in the forest. Had to rely on the map a lot.
Well Kept, lots of Shade, but Sandy
Nice trail. Well kept. The app really allowed us to explore paths that we would not have otherwise taken out of fear of getting lost.

Trails are well maintained. 
Surprisingly no bugs in the end of July.
Beautiful little lake and streams.
Gorgeous trail where kids had a great time. There is a pond where they tried catching minnows with little nets.
Easy flat, Sandy trail and lots of paths you can take. Saw some people riding horses so beware of some horse droppings along the way
Great trails that go for hours. Lots of little side trails. Nice and zen

Up and down but wide paths, option for smaller paths through the woods.  Enjoyed it, saw horse poop and bikers but everyone was pleasant.  Finished at 10 am and it was getting busier.  Bugs weren’t that bad.
Great hiking trail, very wide,  and easy to map. Great for family. Main trails very busy. Side/off trails nice and quiet. Only down side was the horse poo. It was on main and side trails.

Definitely very easy trails. You can take a stroller down the main paths easily, if that's your jam. If you're looking for slightly more challenging paths, get off the main trails and you won't see anyone. Beautiful side trails, saw some folks horse back riding which was lovely. You don't have to stick to the loop in this suggested hike, we doubled the length by going on different trails and it was gorgeous. Even with the side trails it's still a very easy hike/walk.
Stop littering. Garbage can at trailhead. Nice trails but you need to leave the main trails if you want to get away from people making noise. Trails not well marked. Nice lake and streams.

Very pretty but gets crowded quickly. There was a lot of people along the main trail, but tons of smaller side trails to get away. The little lake is perfect to let your dog jump in. Big parking area at the trail head.
Good trail for running nice soft underfoot lots of options. Gets busy go early or later!
Nice trail, beautiful lake is surprise!
I love this trail. It is so clean, serene and lots of trail arteries within. Absolutely love it.
Wonderful wide trail, clean, well maintained, lots of route options. Loved it.
Great trail for dogs. Still a little icy. Trail was becoming muddy this week.

Very nice trail. Popular spot for cross country skiing. Some hills for tobogganing directly south of car park off of Highway 48 entrance. Water features along the trail: lovely meandering stream and a pond.
great trail even if it was snow covered. definitely will hike this trail again.
Kind of confusing to follow with all the leaves. Needed the map and gps. Nice trail lots of ups and downs. Good place to walk your dog offleash
Very nice place, woods and forest, trails are very clear and plenty of them, so you can basically choose and not really follow a recording. Pretty easy, good for hiking with kids or dogs.

Nice June day. Park is very well maintained; trails were in excellent condition considering how wet the spring has been. Nice pond in the northwest corner (pictured) for dogs to swim in, although it was busy there on a Fathers Day Sunday. Ample parking at the lot accessed from Hwy 48. Be careful as you approach the turnoff from the highway; the “Eldred King Tract” sign isn’t large.
